chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I said: A man disavows his child after having acknowledged him. So he said: “If the child is from a free woman, he is flogged fifty lashes, the hadd of a slave; but if he is from a bondwoman, then nothing is upon him.”

key_terms.حَدَّ الْمَمْلُوكِ: the fixed punishment of a slave

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man denies his child after having already acknowledged him?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who denies paternity after previously acknowledging the child. It distinguishes between the child being born from a free woman or a bondwoman, assigning a hadd punishment in the former case and no penalty in the latter.
